live_displays.rationale: High contrast white/gold on deep charcoal (#0A0D14) for maximum legibility from the back row in sanctuary environments without distracting light bleed.

operator_consoles.rationale: Command center aesthetic with crisp 1px borders, subtle surface contrast, clear visual status indicators, and distinct live output mirrors.

rules.live_display_numbers: text-6xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl font-black tracking-tight font-display
rules.live_display_scripture: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold leading-relaxed max-w-5xl
rules.live_display_reference: text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400 font-display
rules.admin_headers: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-display tracking-tight text-slate-100

live_register.portrait_1080x1920: flex flex-col h-screen w-screen p-8 lg:p-12 gap-6 justify-center
live_register.landscape_1920x1080: grid grid-cols-2 grid-rows-2 h-screen w-screen p-10 lg:p-16 gap-8 items-stretch

live_bible.viewport_fill: flex flex-col justify-between h-screen w-screen p-12 lg:p-20 bg-[#090B10] text-slate-50 text-center relative overflow-hidden
live_bible.scripture_container: flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center max-w-6xl mx-auto

admin_consoles.container: min-h-screen bg-[#0B0E14] text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-8
admin_consoles.pin_gate: min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#090B10] p-4

image_urls.usage_note: Use only as subtle background texture with minimum opacity (10-15%) or blur overlay on idle slides to maintain crisp readability.

key_features_and_components.websocket_status_pill: Top-right corner indicator showing live WS state (Connected = Green dot with subtle ring glow, Reconnecting = Yellow pulse, Disconnected = Red warning) with data-testid='ws-status-badge'.
key_features_and_components.register_display: Four primary metric blocks: Attendance This Week, Offering This Week, Attendance Previous Week, Offering Previous Week. Format monetary values clean with currency symbol. Exactly 7-day prior matching or N/A.
key_features_and_components.register_admin: 4-digit PIN gate input (data-testid='pin-input'). Form with Service Date, Label, Attendance, Offering, Quick Numeric Incrementers (+10, +50, +100, +$100, +$500), and Publish button with clear active state.
key_features_and_components.bible_display: Scripture slide container. Handles large dynamic verse scaling, translation badge, verse reference footer, and clean idle state slide when no verse is active.
key_features_and_components.bible_admin: PIN gate, translation manager (CSV upload dropzone, translation list, deletion modal), quick lookup field (Book Chapter:Verse e.g. John 3:16), verse preview card, manual edit textarea, Prev/Next slide controls, Live Publish button, and Clear-to-Idle CTA.

component_guidelines.shadcn_components: Use custom styled Shadcn components in src/components/ui/ for Dialogs, Cards, Inputs, Selects, Buttons, Tabs, and Toasts.
component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner (`sonner`) toast notifications located at `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` for operator actions (e.g. Published, Translation Deleted, Service Saved).
component_guidelines.testing_attribute_requirement: EVERY interactive element and primary output data display MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case e.g. data-testid='publish-register-btn', data-testid='attendance-this-week-value', data-testid='bible-lookup-input', data-testid='pin-input'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all file paths are JavaScript (.js / .jsx).
Inject Google Fonts (Outfit & Manrope) in public/index.html or top-level CSS.
Ensure WebSocket real-time updates broadcast instantly to all connected /register and /bible displays.
Validate screen orientation on /register to automatically apply flex-col for portrait and 2x2 grid for landscape.
Avoid fancy drop-shadows or gradients on scripture slides to prevent projection distortion.
